library_name: Destiny Jedi Academy Final Character Options
notes: Remaining feats, Sith Alchemy talents, Force techniques, and Force secrets from the Jedi Academy Training Manual.

rules.name: Cause Mutation
rules.description: Transform a willing or helpless creature into a Sith abomination or chrysalis beast.

mechanics.use: Work for a number of days equal to the resulting creature's modified Challenge Level, then spend 1 Force Point.
mechanics.effect: Apply either the Sith Abomination or Chrysalis Beast template. The mutated creature counts as domesticated for you alone unless already domesticated.

rules.name: Rapid Alchemy
rules.description: Briefly alter a melee weapon to improve its accuracy or empower one damaging strike.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 equipment bonus on attacks with it for the encounter. Once during that encounter, sacrifice this bonus as a free action for +5 equipment bonus on one damage roll with it.

rules.name: Sith Alchemy
rules.description: Create Sith amulets, dark armor, offensive talismans, and alchemically treated Sith weapons.

mechanics.cost: Each transformation increases Dark Side Score by 1 and normally requires a Force Point.
mechanics.amulet: Spend 25,000 credits in materials and one week of work, then 1 Force Point, to create a Sith amulet.
mechanics.armor: Transform battle armor into matching light, medium, or heavy dark armor in 1/2/3 days; spend a Force Point at completion.
mechanics.talisman: Full-round action and 1 Force Point creates a carried talisman adding +1d6 damage to damaging Force powers. Only one active; after destruction, wait 24 hours.
mechanics.weapon: Spend 1 hour and 1 Force Point treating a simple or advanced melee weapon. Lightsabers no longer ignore its DR; proficient users may use it with Block, Deflect, Redirect Shot, and their prerequisites. Its wielder may spend a Force Point as a swift action to add Dark Side Score to the next damage roll that encounter, increasing Dark Side Score by 1.

rules.name: Sith Alchemy Specialist
rules.description: Add a specialized alchemical trait to dark armor, a Sith abomination, or a Sith weapon.

mechanics.use: Spend 1 uninterrupted hour and 1 Force Point; increase Dark Side Score by 1.
mechanics.effect: Apply one eligible trait: armor may gain cortosis weave, +2 dark-side Use the Force, +2 stealth Use the Force, or +2 intimidation; an abomination may gain DR 5/increase DR 5, +2 Will, or poisoned natural weapons; a Sith weapon may inflict delayed 1d4 damage, grant +2 Block/Deflect, or remain Sith-poisoned.
mechanics.special: Only one modification at a time and normally one trait per object; the same benefit cannot stack with itself.

rules.name: Follow Through
rules.description: After dropping an enemy in melee, carry your momentum across the battlefield.

mechanics.trigger: A melee attack reduces an opponent to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: Immediately move up to your speed, once per turn.
mechanics.special: With Cleave, you may make this movement before the extra Cleave attack.

rules.name: Force Regimen Mastery
rules.description: Learn structured Force-training regimens that provide benefits after successful practice.

mechanics.effect: Learn Force regimens equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier, minimum 1.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for the same number of additional regimens. A permanent Wisdom-modifier increase adds one regimen per instance of this feat.

rules.name: Long Haft Strike
rules.description: Use both ends of an oversized lightsaber as a double weapon.

mechanics.effect: A lightsaber pike or long-handle lightsaber may be used as a double weapon, following that weapon's individual double-weapon profile.

rules.name: Relentless Attack
rules.description: A missed attack improves your next attempt against the same target.

mechanics.selection: Choose a weapon group or exotic weapon for which you possess Double Attack.
mechanics.trigger: Miss a target with the selected weapon.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence bonus on your next attack against that target made before the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different weapon group or exotic weapon.

rules.name: Unswerving Resolve
rules.description: Resisting fear or mental domination produces a brief reserve of Force energy.

mechanics.trigger: A fear or mind-affecting effect targets you but fails to affect you.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point, lost if unused by the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: You gain nothing if you actively negate the effect, such as with Rebuke.

rules.name: Cure Disease
rules.description: Allow Vital Transfer to purge disease as well as restore health.

mechanics.trigger: Use Vital Transfer on a diseased target.
mechanics.check: Compare the Use the Force activation result with the disease's Treat Injury DC.
mechanics.effect: If the check meets the DC, spend a Force Point to cure that disease.

rules.name: Extended Blind
rules.description: Increase the distance at which Blind can affect a target.

mechanics.effect: Blind's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Disarm
rules.description: Increase Force Disarm's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Disarm's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Grip
rules.description: Increase Force Grip's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Grip's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Thrust
rules.description: Increase Force Thrust's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Thrust's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Move Object
rules.description: Increase Move Object's reach.

mechanics.effect: Move Object's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Improved Convection
rules.description: Make fire ignited by Convection scale with your combat training.

mechanics.effect: Fire caused by Convection attacks the target's Fortitude Defense using your base attack bonus instead of the fire effect's normal +5 attack bonus.

rules.name: Improved Crucitorn
rules.description: Retain Crucitorn when the attack still overwhelms your Damage Threshold.

mechanics.effect: If the attack or Force power still deals damage exceeding your Damage Threshold after Crucitorn, that use is not expended and remains in your suite.

rules.name: Improved Cryokinesis
rules.description: Extend Cryokinesis to occupied vehicles.

mechanics.effect: Cryokinesis may target an occupied vehicle in range; it moves down the condition track only if your activation result also exceeds its Fortitude Defense.

rules.name: Improved Fold Space
rules.description: Transport Fold Space targets across line of sight or throughout a star system.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to move the target anywhere in line of sight, or spend a Destiny Point to move it anywhere in the same star system.

rules.name: Improved Force Light
rules.description: Blind creatures harmed by Force Light.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point so creatures damaged by Force Light grant concealment to all other targets through the end of their next turns. Spend a Destiny Point instead to make it total concealment.

rules.name: Improved Force Storm (JATM)
rules.description: Fill the acid storm with targeted Force lightning.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point when activating the storm. On activation and each standard action used to maintain it, compare your check with one creature's Reflex Defense inside; success deals 3d6 Force damage. Spend a Destiny Point to deal 6d6 instead.

rules.name: Improved Plant Surge
rules.description: Expand Plant Surge into an area restraint.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to target all enemies in a 5x5-square area with at least one square in range, or a Destiny Point for a 10x10-square area.

rules.name: Improved Thought Bomb
rules.description: Greatly enlarge Thought Bomb's affected area.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to target every enemy within 5 squares, or a Destiny Point to target every enemy in line of sight.

rules.name: Holocron Loremaster
rules.description: Temporarily draw a nearby ally's known Force power into your suite and imprint your knowledge into holocrons.

mechanics.trigger: Whenever you activate a Force power.
mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to add one use of any Force power known by an ally within 12 squares to your suite. Once used, that granted use cannot be regained.
mechanics.duration: If unused, it disappears at the end of your next turn; spend a Destiny Point to retain it through encounter end.
mechanics.special: You may enhance a holocron you possess with your knowledge and create a gatekeeper in your image.

rules.name: Mentor
rules.description: Temporarily place a Force power you just activated into a nearby ally's suite.

special: Successfully trained an apprentice to knighthood or equivalent rank

mechanics.trigger: Whenever you activate a Force power.
mechanics.target: One ally within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to add one use of that power to the ally's suite. Once used, the granted use cannot be regained.
mechanics.duration: If unused, it disappears at the end of the ally's next turn; either participant may spend a Destiny Point to retain it through encounter end.
